test_title: PYST 65: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Point B is 35 m to the east of Point A. Point C is 26 m to the north of Point A. Point C is 15 m to the west of Point D. Point E is 13 m to the south of Point D. Point F is 20 m to the east of Point E. In which direction is Point B with respect to Point F?
solution:
Given: 

Point B is 35 m to the east of Point A.

Point C is 26 m to the north of Point A.

Point C is 15 m to the west of Point D.

Point E is 13 m to the south of Point D.

Point F is 20 m to the east of Point E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5bf946b2b09d69bc2a78bd1184f685935830e3f03901ac17617824205570fbaf.png] 

So, Point B is in **South** direction of Point F.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
